content:
Apple’s next major announcement is only a week away with WWDC 2026 set for Monday, June 8. Now Apple’s Greg “Joz” Joswiak has shared a new promo for the big keynote address with an upbeat message.

Apple also has an official wallpaper for WWDC that you can download for free. And there’s an official Apple Music playlist to go along with the fun.

‘All systems glow for a great WWDC26 next week’

First, here’s the fun new promotional teaser from Joz that kicks off the one-week countdown until iOS 27 and more are unveiled:

The playful music and animated Apple glow gives us a taste of the energy to expect next week.

Apple also has a new YouTube video to get everyone ready for next week:

There’s also an official Apple Music playlist from Apple that you can find here.

It’s all available from the official WWDC 2026 website.

Apple has an official ‘Glow all out’ WWDC wallpaper for your iPhone, iPad, and Mac

Next, you can join in on the excitement with Apple’s official WWDC 2026 wallpaper.

Just go to this website on your device to find the full resolution wallpaper for your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. See a lower-res version of the Mac wallpaper below.

The WWDC keynote starts on Monday, June 8, at 10 am PT/1 pm ET. 9to5Mac’s Chance Miller will be at Apple Park, and the 9to5Mac team will bring you the latest from Cupertino all week long.
